summary: Implemented `Perc` as a Stat using `GroupBy.apply`, NumPy percentile methods, and the NumPy 1.22 keyword compatibility switch. Exported it through `seaborn.objects`, added API and release note entries, and documented its parameters and examples. The focused tests passed: 13 passed. `git diff --check` passed; the run reported existing Matplotlib deprecation warnings. I did not run the full suite or build the docs.
